_design_note: M3.7. The sole change from M3.3LX is agent.algorithm, q_learning -> double_dqn (route R02_3 -> R02_4; the two routes differ in that one field). docs/01 section 7.16.5: in 92.1 percent of the fatal last ticks the saving move was plainly visible in handcrafted_v3 and the agent chose WAIT, and A06's shaping did not favour WAIT either (mean shaping difference -0.1290). Information and reward both point the right way and the Q values still rank WAIT first, which is what overestimation by the max operator produces. Double DQN decouples the argmax from the value.
